summary: # IN THE APPELLATE TRIBUNAL FOR ELECTRICITY (Appellate Jurisdiction) # APPEAL NO.140 OF 2016 Dated: 29.11.2022 Present: Hon’ble Mr. Justice R.K. Gauba, Officiating Chairperson Hon’ble Mr. Sandesh Kumar Sharma, Technical Member In the matter of: M/s Ramayana Ispat Private Limited A-48, Ground Floor, Wazir Pur Industrial Area, Delhi-110 052 . Appellant(s) ## _VERSUS_ 1. Rajasthan Vidyut Prasaran Nigam Limited Vidhyut Bhawan, Jyoti Nagar Jaipur-302 005, Rajasthan 2. Jaipur Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited Vidyut Bhawan, Jaipur-302 005 3. Rajasthan State Electricity Regulatory Commission Vidhyut Viniyamak Bhawan Jaipur – 302005, Rajasthan . Counsel for the Appellant (s) : Mr. Manu Seshadri Mr. Aveak Ganguly Counsel for the Respondent (s) : Mr. Pradeep Misra Mr. Manoj Kr. Sharma for R-1 Mr. Sanjay Agarwal Mr. Naman Mittal for R-2 Mr. Raj Kumar Mehta Ms. Himanshi Andley for R-3 . Respondents # J U D G M E N T (Oral) PER HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE R.K. GAUBA, OFFICIATING CHAIRPERSON **_1._** The appellant had approached the third respondent, _Rajasthan Electricity Regulatory Commission_ (hereinafter referred to variously as, “RERC” or “State Commission”) by Petition no. RERC-503/15 invoking its jurisdiction under Section 86(1)(k) and Section 129 of Electricity Act, 2003 read with _Rajasthan Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms &_ Page **1** of **3** _Appeal no. 140 of 2016_ _Conditions for Open Access) Regulations, 2004_ as well as _Rajasthan Electricity Regulatory Commission (Intra-State ABT) Regulations, 2006_ raising grievances as to non-settlement of UI account by the first and second respondents herein (beneficiaries). The said petition was disposed of by the State Commission by Order dated 09.03.2016 holding that no relief could be granted to the petitioner, the case of the petitioner being similar to that of _M/s Shree Cement Ltd_ decided earlier by the State Commission by Order dated 04.12.2015, observing as under: _“12 _ _“13. As regards setting of past accounts as per deviation settlement mechanism of RERC (Intra-State ABT) Regulations, 2006 we find that it can be implemented only after procurement, installation and commissioning of ABT & ToD meters and their integration with SLDC which is also requirement of ABT Regulations, 2006. So long as the said system is not installed, the SLDC will not be able to apportion UI charges as prayed for. We, therefore, hold that the said prayer cannot be accepted as admittedly the system contemplated for implementation of ABT Regulations is not in place and the accounts have to be settled only based on ABT meters installed at all ends and not only based on Petitioner’s metering.”_ **_2._** The appellant in challenge to the above said Order dated 09.03.2016 by the appeal at hand places reliance on two decisions of _Central Electricity Regulatory Commission_ (CERC) rendered on 29.09.2017 in the matters of _Rajasthan Steel Chambers v State Load Despatch Centre & Ors._ and _M/s National Engineering Industries Limited_ _v State Load Despatch Centre & ors._ , reported as 2017 SCC OnLine CERC 296 and 2017 SCC OnLine CERC 297 respectively. Page **2** of **3** _Appeal no. 140 of 2016_ **_3._** The learned counsel for the respondents fairly conceded that the matter may have to be revisited by RERC in light of the view taken by CERC in the above decisions and, therefore, the request for remit, as is now pressed by the appellant, may be granted. **_4._** We order accordingly. **_5._** We set aside the impugned Order dated 09.03.2016 and remit the matter arising out of the Petition no. RERC-503/15 of the appellant to the State Commission (RERC) for fresh consideration and decision, in accordance with law. **_6._** For removal of doubts, if any, we must add that nothing in this judgment shall be treated the expression of opinion by this tribunal either way on the issues which arise. Similarly, we would expect the State Commission to approach the matter afresh with an open mind, not feeling influenced or bound by views taken earlier. All contentions are kept open. # **_7._** The appeal is disposed of in above terms. PRONOUNCED IN THE OPEN COURT ON THIS 29 TH DAY OF NOVEMBER, 2022. (Sandesh Kumar Sharma) Technical Member (Justice R.K. Gauba) Officiating Chairperson _pr/vt_ Page **3** of **3** _Appeal no. 140 of 2016_
